segments.x: The one thing you need to understand about inflation
is that inflation is different for different industries.
So when we talk about the price of things rising over time,
today medical inflation is growing at about 15% per year.
That means every year medical care
is becoming more and more expensive by 15% year on year

text: of overtime. The one thing you need to understand about inflation is that inflation is different for different industries. So when we talk about the price of things rising over time, today medical inflation is growing at about 15% per year. That means every year medical care is becoming more and more expensive by 15% year on year
